summary: EmploymentApplicationDocument manages documents (e.g., resumes, photos, user-defined files) attached to employment applications in HSPnet. It supports searching, adding, deleting, and listing application documents, manages both system and user-defined document types, and handles permissions and validation for document operations.
purpose: To facilitate the upload, retrieval, listing, and management of documents related to an employment application; enabling users (students, staff, agencies) to attach supporting documentation, with controls for anonymity, document type, and access.

workflows.name: Get Employment Application Documents by Application ID
steps: Receive EmploymentApplicationID and user context (studentID, anonymous, isPrivate).
Look up document type codes (named, anonymous, photo) as needed.
Execute EmploymentApplicationDocumentSearch procedure with parameters.
Fill result list with matching EmploymentApplicationDocument records (using FillList logic).
Add user-defined documents if needed using EmploymentApplicationDocumentUserDefinedSearch.
For students viewing their own applications, remove anonymous docs from the result.
Return the documents list.

workflows.name: Add Employment Application Documents
steps: Receive EmploymentApplicationID, StudentDocumentIDList, and addWebPage flag.
Execute EmploymentApplicationDocumentAddDoc procedure.
Collect file paths from the result.
Return file paths of added documents.

workflows.name: Remove Web Page Document
steps: Receive employmentApplicationID.
Execute EmploymentApplicationRemoveWebPage procedure.

workflows.name: Delete Employment Application Document
steps: Receive document instance.
If ID > 0, retrieve full file path.
Attempt to delete the file and containing folder (exceptions ignored).
Delete the document record from the database using EmploymentApplicationDocumentDelete.

workflows.name: Validate Document Before Save
steps: Check FileURL and FilePath are not blank.
Check TypeCodeID is nonzero.
If checks fail, add error message and stop operation.

business_rules: A document must have a non-blank FileURL and FilePath to be valid.
A document must have a nonzero TypeCodeID.
If viewing as a student (sess.StaffID == studentID), anonymous docs are not shown.
If no named/anonymous/photo/user-defined doc exists, supply a placeholder entry with default properties and no document available.
Document type code may be appended with comments and Anonymous/Named tags as appropriate.
validations: FileURL is required and cannot be blank.
FilePath is required and cannot be blank.
If validation fails, error messages are added to sess.Messages.
calculations: UpdatedDetails is built from update date, user name (formatted), and agency if present.
TypeCode is augmented with comments and tags (Anonymous/Named) as needed.
If FileURL is not blank and file exists, convert to web link with translated file type and file size in KB.
conditions: If document is uploaded by student, use student name/agency fields; else use staff's.
If userDefined and anonymous, only include entry if both 'anonymous' context and entry.Anonymous are true.
If system is in alt language mode, use TypeCodeAlt field for type code.
system_behavior: Searches invoke stored procedures with contextually constructed parameters.
Deletion attempts to remove both file and parent directory, ignoring exceptions.
Addition of documents returns physical file paths added.
Anonymous and user-defined document rows are programmatically added as needed to maintain business logic.
dependencies: Relies on Codes.CodeSearchID to resolve document type codes for resume/photo.
Uses Resources and UI.Localization for translated strings and file type descriptors.

Database stored procedures: EmploymentApplicationDocumentSearch, EmploymentApplicationDocumentUserDefinedSearch, EmploymentApplicationDocumentAddDoc, EmploymentApplicationRemoveWebPage, EmploymentApplicationDocumentDelete.
exceptions: File or directory delete failures are ignored.
Validation failure halts further operations and adds an error.
If no matching documents, placeholder entries may be returned.
